verdicts.candidate: Unity at a time, strict identity through time, and causal coherence are interchangeable.
verdicts.basis: T 1.4.2.26–30 and T 1.4.6.6–22 explicitly distinguish relevant ideas and attributions.

verdicts.candidate: Criticism of strict identity entails a denial of all composition.
verdicts.basis: T 1.4.6.8 conditionally permits a composite mass's perfect identity; .22 criticizes simplicity rather than every related whole; App.15 retains composition language.
verdicts.qualification: This does not independently refute every comprehensive ontological composition nihilism.

verdicts.candidate: Causal connectedness supplies a completed account of personal unity.
verdicts.basis: App.20–21 declares the uniting explanation unsatisfactory; causal relations also cross persons.
verdicts.qualification: No particular secondary author's argument is adjudicated.

verdicts.candidate: Stable character independently establishes personal identity.
verdicts.basis: T 1.4.6.19 allows character change; T 3.3.1.4–5 already concern a person's conduct.
verdicts.safe_role: defeasible evidence within an empirically tracked personal history

verdicts.candidate: Spatial unity can coexist with denial of strict temporal identity in changing complexes.
